QUST.name: Quest
QUST.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/QUST. A quest nests four kinds of list inside one record: the quest stages (each INDX with one or more log entries), the quest objectives (each QOBJ with one or more quest targets), and the aliases (each ALST or ALLS with a list of fields). The same signature means different things in different lists — FNAM is an objective's flag in the objective list and an alias's flags in the alias list — so the record is a sequence of blocks. [measured: 1,811 QUST records in Skyrim.esm, with 12,891 aliases, 11,999 alias endings, 14,343 objective flags and 11,427 conditions]

ALCA.name: Create At
ALCA.note: The high bit says whether to create at or in; the rest is the AliasID to create the object at or in.

ALCL.name: Create Level
ALCL.note: 0 = Easy, 1 = Medium, 2 = Hard, 3 = Very Hard, 4 = None.

ALCO.name: Alias Created Object
ALCO.note: A base record to create an instance of and assign to this alias.

ALDN.name: Display Name
ALDN.note: A MESG record whose value becomes the alias target's displayed name.

ALEA.name: External Alias
ALEA.note: The AliasID to use in the external quest.

ALED.name: End Of Alias
ALED.note: Zero-length; marks the end of the alias.

ALEQ.name: External Alias Reference
ALEQ.note: The quest the alias should be copied from. ALEA gives the AliasID in that quest.

ALFA.name: Alias Reference
ALFA.note: The AliasID of a reference or location alias within this quest, depending on the alias's own type.

ALFC.name: Alias Factions
ALFC.note: A FACT record, added to the alias target for the duration of the quest.

ALFD.name: Event Data
ALFD.note: The Event Data dropdown's value, a four-character code. Its meaning varies with the event type.

ALFE.name: From Event
ALFE.note: The type of event, a four-character code matching an SMEN short name, for example "Script". It is not NUL-terminated. ALFD gives the event's extra data.

ALFI.name: Forced Into Alias
ALFI.note: The AliasID of another alias to copy this one into.

ALFL.name: Alias Forced Location
ALFL.note: A fixed LCTN to assign to this alias. It also becomes the quest's default location.

ALFR.name: Alias Forced Reference
ALFR.note: The ACHR or REFR to assign to this alias.

ALID.name: Alias Name
ALID.note: The alias's name, for example Location or QuestGiver. It appears in the strings that are updated from the quest's details.

ALLS.name: Alias ID (Location)
ALLS.note: The alias's numerical value, for a location alias.

ALNA.name: Near Alias
ALNA.note: The AliasID this one must be near.

ALPC.name: Alias Package Data
ALPC.note: A PACK record, added to the alias target for the duration of the quest.

ALRT.name: Alias Reference Type
ALRT.note: The LCRT used to find the object to assign to this alias.

ALSP.name: Alias Spells
ALSP.note: A SPEL record, added to the alias target for the duration of the quest.

ALST.name: Alias ID
ALST.note: The alias's numerical value, the parameter for functions such as LocAliasHasKeyword. ALST is a reference alias and ALLS is a location alias.

ALUA.name: Alias Unique Actor
ALUA.note: The NPC_ whose existing instance is used, rather than a new one being created.

CNTO.name: Items
CNTO.note: An item added to the alias target's inventory for the duration of the quest.

COCT.name: Item Count
COCT.note: How many CNTO records follow. It may be absent even when there are CNTO records.

CTDA.name: Match Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions used to find a matching reference or location.

FNAM.name: Flags
FNAM.note: The alias's flags. 0x01 Reserves, 0x02 Optional, 0x04 Quest Object, 0x08 Allow Reuse In Quest, 0x10 Allow Dead, 0x20 In Loaded Area, 0x40 Essential, 0x80 Allow Disabled, 0x100 Stores Text, 0x200 Allow Reserved, 0x400 Protected, 0x800 No Fill Type, 0x1000 Allow Destroyed, 0x2000 Closest, 0x4000 Uses Stored Text, 0x8000 Initially Disabled, 0x10000 Allow Cleared, 0x20000 Clears Name When Removed.

GWOR.name: Guard Warn Override
GWOR.note: The guard warn override package list (FLST). Never used in the main game files.

KWDA.name: Alias Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record, added to the alias for the duration of the quest. There is one per KSIZ.

OCOR.name: Observe Dead Body Override
OCOR.note: The observe dead body override package list (FLST). Never used in the main game files.

VTCK.name: Voice Type
VTCK.note: Additional valid voice types for export. When non-zero, points to NPC_ or FLST records.

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions that apply to this target.

FNAM.name: Flags
FNAM.note: 0x01 = ORed With Previous. This FNAM is the objective's flag, not the alias's.

NNAM.name: Node Name
NNAM.note: The text of the individual quest objective.

QOBJ.name: Index
QOBJ.note: The quest objective's index. By convention it matches a quest stage's index, but that is a convention and not enforced; what actually controls when an objective appears is the script attached to the stage.

QSTA.name: Quest Target
QSTA.note: The objective's target: the alias it points at and whether its compass marker ignores locks.

ALED.name: End Of Alias
ALED.note: Zero-length; marks the end of the alias.

ALID.name: Alias Name
ALID.note: The alias's name, for example Location or QuestGiver. It appears in the strings that are updated from the quest's details.

ALLS.name: Alias ID (Location)
ALLS.note: The alias's numerical value, for a location alias.

ALST.name: Alias ID
ALST.note: The alias's numerical value, the parameter for functions such as LocAliasHasKeyword. ALST is a reference alias and ALLS is a location alias.

CNAM.name: Journal Entry
CNAM.note: The index in the string file for the journal entry's text.

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions that apply to this log entry.

FNAM.name: Flags
FNAM.note: The alias's flags. 0x01 Reserves, 0x02 Optional, 0x04 Quest Object, 0x08 Allow Reuse In Quest, 0x10 Allow Dead, 0x20 In Loaded Area, 0x40 Essential, 0x80 Allow Disabled, 0x100 Stores Text, 0x200 Allow Reserved, 0x400 Protected, 0x800 No Fill Type, 0x1000 Allow Destroyed, 0x2000 Closest, 0x4000 Uses Stored Text, 0x8000 Initially Disabled, 0x10000 Allow Cleared, 0x20000 Clears Name When Removed.

INDX.name: Journal Index
INDX.note: The quest stage: its journal index and flags. More than one log entry may follow, one for each possible journal text.

QNAM.name: Unknown
QNAM.note: An unknown field, 4 bytes. It appears in the stage block after the SCHR.

QSDT.name: Flags
QSDT.note: Each QSDT marks the start of a log entry. 0x01 = Complete Quest, 0x02 = Fail Quest.

ANAM.name: Next Alias ID
ANAM.note: The next available alias id, an incremental counter the CK uses when it creates a new alias in the ALST and ALLS fields.

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions that apply to the quest as a whole, and — after the NEXT marker — the quest event conditions.

DNAM.name: Quest Data
DNAM.note: The quest's flags, priority and type.

ENAM.name: Event
ENAM.note: A four-character event code matching an SMEN short name. It is not NUL-terminated, so it is read as the whole of the field.

FLTR.name: Object Window Filter
FLTR.note: A path such as "Main Quest\" or "Faction\ThievesGuild\".

FULL.name: Quest Name
FULL.note: The full name as shown in the journal.

NEXT.name: Marker
NEXT.note: Zero-length; it separates the quest's dialogue conditions from its event conditions when only one set is present.

VMAD.name: Script Info
VMAD.note: The only VMAD in the record, and it holds the information about every script attached to the quest, including the stage fragments and the aliases' scripts.
